title: Access
$comment: Generated by `pnpm build` in contracts/ from typespec/. Do not edit.

version.description: The version of the access file's format.

name.description: The name the UI shows, when the provider gives none.

role.description:
`member` sees every page but Secrets and acts on work, runs and gates; `factory-engineer` also changes the factory
from the UI; `admin` also stores and deletes secrets.

items.description: One person: the email the provider verifies, compared in lower case, and their role.

people.description: The people who may sign in. An email appears once.

description:
access.yaml next to factory.yaml (ADR 0134): who may sign in to the factory UI, each person with one role. The
console reads it at each request, so a merge that removes a person ends their access.
